trigger.raw_text: The Customer initiates the use case by clicking on a product category (e.g., gemstones, jewelry, watches) or entering search criteria such as product ID, description text, or attributes like stone, metal, or price range.

claims.content: If the search results in no matches, the system displays a 'No Results Found' page that includes a 'Popular Searches' links section with static lists of popular gemstone and jewelry searches, plus a dynamically updated list of search terms/phrases based on Omniture data.
If the search returns exactly one matching item, the system bypasses the results list and loads the product details page directly.
If the search returns multiple matching items, the system loads a category/search result page using the default catalog view.
After a successful search with exactly one matching item, the system loads the product details page.
After a successful search with multiple matching items, the system loads a category/search result page using the default catalog view.
After a search with no matches, the system displays a 'No Results Found' page that includes a 'Popular Searches' section with static lists and dynamically updated search terms.
No product appears in search results, product details, or catalog pages if it does not have an available image to display.
Closed items are removed from browse and search views within a configured time interval (e.g., 1 minute) before customer access.
